title: Cursor-cell text colour loaded sRGB-encoded in the vertex shader, then re-encoded by the fragment shader that expects linear input
expected_finding: for the text glyph under the cursor, cell_text_vertex sets out.color from load_color(uniforms.cursor_color, ..., linear=false), which returns an sRGB-encoded value; every other path writes a linear colour to out.color, and cell_text_fragment applies unlinearize() to it (use_linear_blending = 0), so the cursor text colour is sRGB-encoded twice
